column1: # Comment census at dffbcd0 — the opening measurement of the comment pass.
# Produced by `weld_lint census`, whose figures were confronted with an
# independently written probe and agree on every quantity: 330 files, 127176
# code lines, 50970 comment lines, 29925 doc lines, 13096 blocks.
#   code  comment  doc  blocks  density  path
# A line is a COMMENT line when its first non-whitespace bytes are `//`, a CODE
# line when it is non-blank and not a comment line; blank lines are in neither,
# and `density` is comment / (comment + code) in percent. A BLOCK is a maximal
# run of consecutive comment lines — the unit of judgement.
# This file is the `before` half of the per-file report. Nothing in it is a
# threshold, a target or a gate.
census: 330 file(s), code 127176, comment 50970 (doc 29925), blocks 13096, density 28.61%
